card.name: Just before a pH value
card.fires_on: The word or space right before a pH number, such as 'at', 'of', or the gap after 'pH'. It appears in urine, solubility, or serum acidity and alkalinity statements.

modes.label: Space after pH
modes.description: The blank spot between 'pH' or 'pH of' and the number.
modes.example: with Drugs That Make the Urine Alkaline The clearance of memantine was reduced by about 80% under alkaline urine conditions at pH<< >>8.

modes.label: 'at' before pH
modes.description: The word 'at' directly before pH in solubility or activity statements.
modes.example: Clinical Effect Nirogacestat is poorly soluble<< at>> pH ≥ 6.

modes.label: Product name before pH
modes.description: A broken-up product name in a heading about timing of use, in a text about acidity.
modes.example: , 50 mg of citric acid, and 20 mg of potassium bitartrate. 2.2 Timing of PHE<<XX>>I Use May use PHEXXI
